svg.title: Brightside Crew Company social visual kit portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional graphic design portfolio concept for Brightside Crew Company, showing abstract social visual tiles across tablet and phone. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
